newsitem.title: USA: ALARIS Medical sees Q2 charges.
newsitem.headline: ALARIS Medical sees Q2 charges.

text.p: ALARIS Medical Inc said Wednesday it expects charges against its second quarter earnings, which it will report this week.

The results will include a $4.1 million charge related to taking operational control of its Mexican manufacturing facilities and a $3.6 million charge related to merger integration. It also expects a a one-time non-cash charge of $4.3 million for the termination of a product development license agreement for ambulatory and alternative site infusion devices with a third party.

ALARIS makes intravenous infusion therapy systems. Its president and chief executive officer, William Mercer said, "it is better for us in the long term to control our Mexican manufacturing facilities," in a statement.
